answer: Biochemical attestation mitigates Sybil attacks in autonomous drone networks by binding agent identities to in-situ nectar sampling. Drones verify physical presence by measuring floral sugar spectra against an onyx reflectance tile, submitting signed proofs to a docking wharf. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of deploying discrete sensor-equipped airframes per persona.
